class_data.name: Lay on Hands
class_data.notes:
Your touch can heal wounds. You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest. The pool's size equals 5 × your Paladin level in Hit Points.

As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (including yourself) and restore Hit Points to it, drawing from your pool. You can restore any amount up to the remaining total.

You can also expend 5 Hit Points from the pool to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points do not also restore Hit Points.

class_data.name: Spellcasting
class_data.notes:
You learn to cast Paladin spells through prayer and meditation.

Spell Slots. The Paladin Features table shows how many spell slots you have to cast level 1+ spells. You regain all expended slots when you finish a Long Rest.

Prepared Spells of Level 1+. You prepare a list of Paladin spells of level 1+ that are available for you to cast. To start, choose two level 1 Paladin spells (Heroism and Searing Smite are recommended). As you gain levels, the number of spells you can prepare increases as shown in the class table. Prepared spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.
If another Paladin feature gives you spells that are always prepared, those spells don’t count against the number of spells you can prepare, but they count as Paladin spells for you.

Changing Prepared Spells. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one prepared spell with another Paladin spell for which you have spell slots.

Spellcasting Ability. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for Paladin spells.

Spellcasting Focus. You can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus for your Paladin spells.

class_data.name: Weapon Mastery
class_data.notes:
You can use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency.
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change which weapons' mastery properties you can use (for example, switching from Longswords and Javelins to Halberds and Flails).

class_data.name: Fighting Style
class_data.notes:
You gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice.

Instead of choosing another Fighting Style, you can choose Blessed Warrior: you learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice (Guidance and Sacred Flame are recommended). These cantrips count as Paladin spells, and Charisma is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Paladin level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Cleric cantrip.

class_data.name: Paladin’s Smite
class_data.notes: You always have the Divine Smite spell prepared. In addition, you can cast Divine Smite once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Long Rest.

class_data.name: Channel Divinity
class_data.notes:
You can channel divine energy to produce magical effects. You start with one effect: Divine Sense. Other Paladin features grant additional Channel Divinity options. Each time you use this class’s Channel Divinity, you choose which of its effects to create.

You can use this class’s Channel Divinity twice. You regain one expended use when you finish a Short Rest and all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You gain an additional use at level 11.

If a Channel Divinity effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals your Paladin spell save DC.

Divine Sense. As a Bonus Action, you open your awareness to detect Celestials, Fiends, and Undead. For 10 minutes, or until you are Incapacitated, you know the location and creature type of any such creature within 60 feet. Within the same radius, you also detect the presence of any place or object that has been consecrated or desecrated, such as by the Hallow spell.

class_data.name: Subclass Feature
class_data.notes:
You choose a Paladin subclass and gain its level 3 feature. You gain additional subclass features at higher Paladin levels.

class_data.name: Ability Score Improvement
class_data.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at levels 8, 12, and 16.

class_data.name: Extra Attack
class_data.notes: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

class_data.name: Faithful Steed
class_data.notes:
You always have the Find Steed spell prepared.
You can also cast Find Steed once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

class_data.name: Aura of Protection
class_data.notes:
You project an invisible aura in a 10-foot emanation originating from you. The aura is inactive while you are Incapacitated.
You and your allies in the aura gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).
If multiple Paladins’ auras overlap, a creature can benefit from only one Aura of Protection at a time, choosing which one while in more than one aura.

class_data.name: Ability Score Improvement
class_data.notes: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

subclass_data.name: Elemental Smite
subclass_data.notes:
Immediately after casting Divine Smite, expend one use of Channel Divinity to invoke one of the following effects:

Dao's Crush. Earth restrains the target of your Divine Smite. The target is Grappled (escape DC = your spell save DC) and Restrained while Grappled.

Djinni's Escape. You teleport to an unoccupied space within 30 feet and become semi-incorporeal until the end of your next turn. You gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and Immunity to Grappled, Prone, and Restrained conditions.

Efreeti's Fury. The target takes an extra 2d4 Fire damage, and a second creature within 30 feet takes 2d4 Fire damage.

Marid's Surge. The target and creatures of your choice within a 10-foot Emanation make Strength saves against your spell save DC. On a failed save, they are pushed 15 feet straight away from you and knocked Prone.

subclass_data.name: Genie Spells
subclass_data.notes:
You always have the following spells prepared at the levels listed:

3rd: Chromatic Orb, Elementalism, Thunderous Smite
5th: Mirror Image, Phantasmal Force
9th: Fly, Gaseous Form
13th: Conjure Minor Elementals, Summon Elemental
17th: Banishing Smite, Contact Other Plane

subclass_data.name: Genie's Splendor
subclass_data.notes:
When not wearing armor, your AC = 10 + Dex mod + Cha mod. You can still use a shield.

You also gain proficiency in one skill of your choice: Acrobatics, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.

subclass_data.name: Aura of Elemental Shielding
subclass_data.notes:
Choose one damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Resistance to that type.

At the start of each of your turns, you can change the chosen type (no action required).
